title: Characterizations of Asplund and Tame Functionals using Arens Products
summary: We investigate the interaction between Arens products on the bidual of a Banach algebra and structural regularity properties of functionals on the algebra. Building on the classical characterization of weakly almost periodic functionals via Arens regularity, we prove new analogous criteria for Asplund and tame functionals.
